newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks fall on bond market weakness.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks fall on bond market weakness.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks fell Thursday, a day after rising to a new high, as long-term interest rates rose despite a successful 30-year Treasury bond auction.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average fell 71.31 points to 8,188.00 after rising 72 points Wednesday. In the broader market, declining issues led advancers by a 4-3 margin on heavy volume of about 580 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
The Nasdaq composite index, laden with technology issues, fell 6.28 to 1,624.16.

Bond prices fell despite strong results at the last leg of the Treasury's quarterly auction. The 30-year Treasury fell 18/32, or $5.63 on a $1,000 bond, raising its yield, which moves in the opposite direction, to 6.52 percent from 6.48 percent Wednesday.
